title: Awotwaa no Bɔhyɛ
intro: Wɔ koma a wɔde ama Ɔsoro de no adan a ɛyɛ komm mu no, wosusuw bɔhyɛ kronkron bi ho. Ná saa bɔhyɛ yi twe adwene si asetra a wonnya ntwee ahome so, na na ne mmamu bɛsakra honhom fam agyapade no kwan koraa. Fa wo nan hyɛ ɔkra bi a ne bɔhyɛ kaa daa no ahintasɛm mu.
clues: Na mete ofie bi a wonim no se ewo nyamesom pa mu, na na m'ani bere akyɛde a ɛbɛma mabɛn Allah.
Me ne m’Awurade yɛɛ apam a anibere wom wɔ nea ahintaw me mu no ho, na mehyɛɛ bɔ sɛ mede ne nyinaa bɛhyɛ Ne som mu.
Bere a bere a wɔde bɛda no adi no dui no, nea menyae no yɛ nea na menhwɛ kwan, nanso mede asɛm no hyɛɛ Onimdefo no nsa.
Memaa me ba no din a ɛkyerɛ ahofama, na mesrɛɛ sɛ wɔmmɔ no ne n’asefo ho ban mfi nea wɔadome no no ho.
Wɔde me ba no too kronkronbea kronkron no mu, wɔ odiyifo bi a ofi Aaron abusua mu hwɛ ase.
Me babea bɛyɛɛ nea wonim no sɛ ne ho tew na wɔpaw no sen mmea nyinaa, akyiri yi ɔbɛyɛɛ odiyifo kɛse bi maame, ɛwom sɛ wɔanka no de.

arabic: إِذْ قَالَتِ ٱمْرَأَتُ عِمْرَٰنَ رَبِّ إِنِّى نَذَرْتُ لَكَ مَا فِى بَطْنِى مُحَرَّرًۭا فَتَقَبَّلْ مِنِّىٓ ۖ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
verse: [Mention, O Muḥammad], when the wife of ʿImrān said, "My Lord, indeed I have pledged to You what is in my womb, consecrated [for Your service], so accept this from me. Indeed, You are the Hearing, the Knowing." (3:35)
